constraints: Root is sole publisher. Marker admission is not implementation. Only listed paths may change. No actual DB/DLL execution, private settings/credentials, deployment, account access changes or live pilot activation.

Other editor profiles and inbound behavior remain unchanged.

Preserve original DTO/key/JSON custody, no retry or new intent after unknown outcome. Save and Submit remain separate; fresh authoritative readback required. Lost browser memory custody blocks further experiment; no invented durable recovery.

Test strict startup/default-off/malformed inputs and full existing HTTP composition through recording providers only. Test real components and adapters for no Remove and no transport on invalid rows, preserving pending/unknown guards and original tests. Exact pinned build/tests and root independent review/hosted CI required before merge.

No dependencies/projects/workflows or general activation framework. Operator document states exact authorization/login/target verification prerequisites and stop procedure. Live read authorization does not constitute activation of this pilot.
